ideas.title: A top you carved, and the ring
ideas.critique: A rigid body whose inertia tensor comes from the profile the player cut, precessing, nutating and flipping as a tippe-top, is physics the island has never had, and the lathe-and-test loop gives a real reason to carve again. The risk is in the contact. If tip friction and top-on-top collisions are fudged, the tippe-top flip won't happen by itself and the battle becomes a random spin-down, and the creatures' tops will read as canned opponents unless they are carved by the same means.

ideas.title: The strongest drop on the island
ideas.critique: This is round 1's Prince Rupert's drops again with a hammer contest added. The quench-stress field deciding where a crack can run is still strong, clippable physics. The hammer gives the player a dial (hot glass, cold water, blow strength), but once the trick is known it is still drip, hit, snip, burst, and the burst can easily fall back to a scripted shard puff instead of a crack running through the solved tension.

ideas.title: An ocarina from a ball of clay
ideas.nearest: Chipping a stone to change its note
same_form: Chipping a stone to change its note
ideas.critique: It is the same payoff as the chipped stone and the lantern: shape a thing, hear its solved note. The new parts are that you play it, hole by hole, and that firing shrinks it and shifts the notes, and it fits the big goal squarely. A Helmholtz formula with breath noise is a lumped approximation, not a solved field, and the friends humming the tune back will be scripted, so the film may sound new but look like Lumi poking a lump.

ideas.title: Lever the boulder
ideas.nearest: A snowball that grows as it rolls, a take that misses
same_form: A snowball that grows as it rolls, a take that misses
ideas.critique: This is round 1's bending stick with a job to do, and its payoff film is once more a single object rolling downhill into the sea, which the snowball already showed. The branch bowing or snapping by its moisture is real, but the player only does it once per boulder, it depends on Lumi's beak and body selling a lean the round-1 critique already doubted, and nothing here is made by hand.
